newsitem.title: USA: SNL Securities says Q3 bank earnings off on charge.
newsitem.headline: SNL Securities says Q3 bank earnings off on charge.

text.p: SNL Securities said Monday it estimates that U.S. commercial banks generated $13.2 billion in net income during the third quarter, a 4.3 percent drop from the previous quarter attributed to one-time charges associated with the replenishment of the Savings Association Insurance Fund.

SNL said that based on results posted by 194 early-reporting banks, which account for 79 percent of the industry's assets, the nation's banks are on pace to generate more than $50 billion in annual net income.
"The SAIF assessment took a toll on what otherwise was an impressive earnings performance for the banking industry," SNL President Reid Nagle said in a statement.
